items.title: Palworld 开发商 Pocketpair 为员工提供 5 天假期来玩 GTA 6
items.summary: Palworld developer Pocketpair is giving its staff five days off to make their way through GTA 6.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/29/gta-6-jason-and-lucia-drive-by-1793234705694.jpg
Palworld developer Pocketpair is giving its staff five days off to make their way through GTA 6 .

“All Pocketpair employees have been granted special leave to attend to an urgent five-day business trip in Vice City when GTA 6 launches,” the company said in a tweet . The company also shared a letter it presumably sent out internally to workers at the studio.

“To all employees,” the letter started. “On November 19, millions of gamers around the world will find themselves sitting at school or work, gazing longingly out the window, knowing that a new era of gaming is about to begin.

“At Pocketpair, we believe that such a historic occasion deserves our full attention. Therefore, after careful consideration, we have decided that all employees who intend to play Grand Theft Auto VI will be granted a special five-day holiday.

The holiday period starts on GTA 6 launch date, November 19, and ends on November 23. “During this period, employees will be excused from their regular duties and are instead encouraged to take a business trip to Vice City,” the letter said.
“We hope everyone enjoys their time away from the office and returns safely from their travels.”

All Pocketpair employees have been granted special leave to attend to an urgent five-day business trip in Vice City when GTA6 launches. Please see the attached notice for details. https://t.co/qJjJ7IvhhY
Pocketpair boss Takuro Mizobe tweeted to confirm he'll be making the most of the special holiday, saying: "Of course, I’ll be taking a break for a while to play GTA6 too!"

Pocketpair isn’t the only company talking about GTA 6’s launch. The developer behind Wardogs encouraged its players to “go play GTA 6” and come back to the game after its next big update. Hardware company Logitech also announced that it will be giving employees time off for GTA 6 . According to a new report, GTA 6 has caused a 17% spike in people requesting time off work , so it’s probably for the best.

Not long now! GTA 6 is out on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. IGN's latest coverage includes speculation about a potential beloved legacy character from a previous game hiding in the latest GTA 6 trailer , and the release of new GTA 6 footage that looks so real fans actually thought it was real-life .

items.title: 康纳·麦格雷戈在《无限战争》制作过程中认识并翻转了一位《使命召唤》开发者：“我希望他做一些真正的身体活动，以展示他的能力”
items.summary: The MMA fighter and failed Irish presidential candidate had a small role in the 2016 shooter.

content.v: Call of Duty doesn't have much luck with its stunt casting. Two years after Infinity Ward put Kevin Spacey in Advanced Warfare—before he was accused of sexual assault—it turned MMA fighter Conor McGregor into a future soldier, Captain Bradley Fillion, in Infinite Warfare .

McGregor's role was quite small, despite being one of the game's antagonists, and ended in his character's demise, but co-directors Jordan Hirsh and Taylor Kurosaki didn't want to cut any corners when it came to the mo-cap.

At the time, co-directors Hirsh and Kurosaki were trying to shake things up in regards to mo-cap. "I think that the folks at Infinity Ward probably thought I was a little crazy when I came in," Kurosaki tells us. "I think for every game they had done before that, you would maybe do some mocap or a cool takedown or a finisher, and then you'd have actors that would come into a VO booth and you'd have them come in one at a time and they'd read their lines and it’d be stitched together and then you're done. And they built a performance capture stage specifically for this project."
With Infinite Warfare, the team was doing full performance capture, so it needed its actors to get more physical.

Kurosaki remembers, after McGregor flipped him, that he "did this punch [right in front of my face] that I could feel the wind from. We're just rehearsing and figuring out the blocking. Everyone on the stage was, ‘Whoa, that was crazy! It was so fast!’ And of course, I had a different perspective than everyone else. Then everyone was laughing, and he helped me up, and I'm laughing. And then all of a sudden, this giant bead of sweat starts running down my face. I had this adrenaline, even though I knew I was perfectly safe. My body was just doing something that I couldn't control."

A few years later, McGregor started racking up criminal charges for assault. In 2019, he attacked a man for not accepting a drink in a Dublin pub. He pleaded guilty. In the same year, police in Ireland started investigating McGregor over allegations of multiple sexual assaults. He was not prosecuted, but a civil claim was made against him by Nikita Hand. In 2024, an Irish jury found that McGregor raped Hand .

Also in 2024, McGregor starred in Hitman, as one of its celebrity Elusive Targets—his second videogame role outside of the UFC games. IO Interactive stopped working with him after the ruling and removed him from the game as an Elusive Target.

Activision, unlike IO, left McGregor in the Infinite Warfare campaign. The fighter has not made any other videogame appearances since then. Prior to the ruling, he was a playable fighter in EA's UFC games, starting in 2014. He was the co-cover athlete in 2016's UFC 2 and the solo cover athlete in 2018's UFC 3. His last appearance in the series was in UFC 5 in 2023.

McGregor has had no scripted television cameos since 2024, appearing strictly as himself for promotional spots and interviews—including a guest appearance on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon in June 2026. Fallon and NBC were heavily criticised for inviting McGregor onto the show. He is also attached to host and executive-produce a Fox Nation competition series titled World's Baddest Man, slated for 2027.

items.title: 魔兽世界：永远的新河谷地区感觉更像是燃烧的远征+而不是经典+，你知道吗，我对此绝对同意
items.summary: Close enough. Welcome back, Nagrand.

content.v: So I've been utterly consumed by WoW: Forever, which is a relief, because it's my job to write about it—and I've been powering ahead to 40, where a deeply oldschool grind to get my first mount awaits me. Before that, though, I had an absolutely lovely time futzing around The Riverglades, one of WoW: Forever's properly bespoke zones. As in, this thing wasn't in vanilla. This was cooked up and released in November.
Having quested through most of it in a blissful fugue state with some friends, we each came to the conclusion that it all feels very 2007, rather than 2006.

The Riverglades, which you can head to at about level 38, is saturated with quests. Even more so than the revamped and revisited zones from vanilla World of Warcraft. And while it absolutely has the classic zone's sense of scale, and none of these quests have the retail aura of on-rails cutscenes about them, I wasn't actually tasting vanilla .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/n4NYbVqmz34dkzcdkUCuzA-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/JZvN3SDTBdnQqAYerNsz5B-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/CNzRgn74H9QnrYLSYCKvyA-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/9MviixFtL2uKjrGW4rRVsA-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/VcwJ8kacFsAVzxT9pdsBqA-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/M468cwcQutVSyhiQd5AcBA-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/mG3uQ5d2pv7CuAQfszgp8A-1920-80.png

One of the hallmarks of older, classic-style quest design is a bunch of disparate quests that have you scattering out towards the map—Riverglades, then, feels a lot more modern, in that it uses that scattershot point-of-interest guide as a baseline, then cleverly tucks away even more quests at your destination.

In one case, fighting through a ruined village flooded with Twilight's Blade, me and my compatriot saw a quest marker underground. It took ages for us to find a basement, which then yawned out into an open cavern with shadow-infused ogres and a cunning woman trapped in a cage with her own quest chain.

At which point it clicked: Oh, I'm playing The Burning Crusade again. The template was classic, sure, but the density and the branching paths and the clever redirects—that's all Outland, baby. There's even a set of swampy flats in the middle of The Riverglades pock-marked by orcish poachers that made me say, out loud: Oh, I'm in Nagrand again. Just without the floating islands.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2ciknZYTnr7KS2uvBF9YWA-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/r24PDUMB8LCKE8SxV3APXA-1920-80.png
And you know what, having had this unexpectedly adjacent nostalgic experience, I didn't hate it.

I do hope that Forever manages to preserve its more Vanilla aspects; I've written on this site quite recently about how I've adored just going on an adventure. Heck, I had the terrible idea to do the Scarlet Monastery as Alliance recently, and the quest chain leading up to the sword I wanted forced me to run all the way across Desolace to fight level 40 skeletons. It was great.

But The Burning Crusade, in many senses, was the best of both worlds. WoW hadn't been claimed by its Cataclysm-era propensity for goofs and pop culture references over atmosphere yet, but it also hadn't stuck doggedly to its vanilla quest design that was sometimes just flat-out bad.

In fact, many of Forever's new quests, even in other zones, have been built around plugging up awkward questing gaps, or giving players more to do in zones that've been otherwise barren. Which, as it turns out, just produces Outland 2.0. If the other levelling zones Blizzard adds to Forever are as Nagrand-flavoured as the Riverglades, I really don't mind at all.

items.title: 英伟达是如何陷入困境的：黄仁勋丑闻的时间表和导致其的地缘政治
items.summary: We're hearing a lot more about this now, but this story didn't totally begin with Jensen's admission of an aff

content.v: Nvidia is the talk of the world right now. The company's co-founder Jensen Huang has been ousted from the company , following claims of multiple affairs: one said to be with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, and another an alleged with an executive at Nvidia.

These events and more had put pressure on the company's board to consider ousting the co-founder and CEO, who has now been replaced by CFO Colette Kress acting as interim CEO; at least until a suitable replacement can be found.
To better understand these events, the wider context of what's at stake, and why chip smuggling and export controls are also a part of the conversation, check out our timeline below.
October 29
New York Times report on Jensen Huang's unclear relationship with an alleged Chinese spy, Alice Huang.
Alice Huang was the managing director of Megaspeed, a datacentre company in Singapore that imported billions of dollars worth of Nvidia GPUs. Her husband, Kang Wei, is a private equity investor.
Megaspeed had been subject to an investigation for chip smuggling, but Nvidia and the company say it was cleared of suspicion.

Megaspeed statement from December, 25: "We want to be absolutely clear: over the past six months, our company has undergone multiple on-site inspections and reviews by key institutions, including the Bureau of Industry and Security of the US Commerce Department, the Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry of Malaysia, and Nvidia. These thorough investigations have confirmed that there has been no evidence of any violations concerning the illicit transfer of chips or any illegal activities."
Nvidia spokesperson, John Rizzo, said at the time accusations of chip smuggling made against Megaspeed were "thoroughly investigated and debunked last year."
However, during that investigation, Alice Huang is said to have come under suspicion by US authorities, who determined that Alice Huang was working as an intelligence asset for China.
China denies the claims .
Authorities also noted Jensen Huang was close to Alice Huang, though their exact relationship was not specified.
Rizzo said: “Jensen’s interactions with Ms. Huang are not unusual or unexpected. Meetings with customers are part of a CEO’s job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year.”

It is said at this time that neither Jensen nor Nvidia had been briefed on foreign intelligence threats by the US government, despite prior memos in the government and US authorities deeming her a threat.
November 5
Jensen is called to a meeting with the various national security and foreign affairs committee leaders in US Congress on November 18.

On the meeting for this agenda is Alice Huang: Jensen's relationship with her and whether she could have collected sensitive information about US technology. It's also about Nvidia's security protocols.
This presumably puts some pressure on Huang and Nvidia to be seen to take action.
November 8
Jensen Huang and Nvidia's board put out statements at the same time on Nvidia's newsroom.
Jensen's statement admits he was having an affair with an unnamed person. He apologises to wife and family, his staff, and says he has fallen short of his responsibility to them.
In the same statement, he notes national security concerns arising from news reports:

"Nvidia’s Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America’s national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hDXrgCW7orc9QX5Kz9msPD-1920-80.jpg
The board of Nvidia focuses on the reports of a "foreign intelligence effort" against the company's CEO and launches an independent investigation to check.

"While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, the Board's inquiry will examine all available information. Jensen fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it."
That same day and immediate days thereafter
The share price for Nvidia drops: around 21% since October 28, the day prior to the initial New York Times report.
This also happens to be around a similar time of a wider tech selloff due to AI fears, midterm elections, and opposition to datacentres.

Nvidia loses a couple hundred billion dollars in value, give or take. It's share price is not quite the lowest it's been this year—that was on March 30. That was driven by fears of AI spending slowing, CapEx, and China export rules. So it's not apocalyptic for the company.
November 9
Donald Trump speaks to press about his pal, Jensen Huang. He's generally very positive and seems to back the Nvidia CEO .
Trump asked if Jensen Huang had any idea Alice Huang was a spy. Jensen Huang said no.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/oGqBJSkoz3LLzrdKxzECAD-1920-80.jpg

Trump was reportedly informed of Alice Huang much earlier, but suggested he did not regret not acting on that advice sooner: "No, I don't think so. I think he's an honourable guy. I think he probably has an excuse for it."
"He's an amazing guy. I just hope there's no problem. If there is a problem, we'll let you know about it."
Trump also casually mentions the FBI are investigating.
November 10

Law firms start flooding in with requests for Nvidia investors to sign up to class-action lawsuits or "investigations" into the company. I saw around five press releases for law firms offering their services to investors hoping to claim back some money, but there are reportedly even more.

The Rosen Law Firm's complaint ( PDF ) outlines ways that Nvidia may have made misleading or false statements on Jensen Huang, his relationship with Alice Huang, and didn't express the risks to the company and share price adequately.
Nvidia hires law firm Wachtell Lipton to lead Jensen Huang affair probe.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/g9q7QM5KH2vKcorscHULj7-1920-80.jpg
Report by The Information suggests Alice Huang facilitated some 240k AI GPUs, largely at-the-time banned H100 and H200 chips, roughly costing around $7.5B

It is speculated that Alice Huang was introduced to Jensen Huang by her investor husband, who had interest in gaming companies. It is also speculated whether she was picked up by Chinese intelligence after starting a relationship with Huang, rather than the other way around.

Axios reports that Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick was sent a classified memo warning over the relationship between Jensun and Alice Huang. Lutnick is the one charged with safeguarding US technology and keeping it away from its perceived rivals.
The report also notes that Marco Rubio warned Trump about Huang being potentially spied upon on Airforce 1 directly before they picked up Jen-Hsun for the China trip.
Huang returns to a "sad" Nvidia office but seems to act business as usual.
November 11
US senator says he has to go .

"… If the worst thing he did in real life is infidelity with ⁠this woman who may or may not be a Chinese spy—but she might be—that's enough, because whatever else there is, we don't know. And to me, that's a security risk."
November 11
Jensen Huang claimed to have yet another affair, this time it is alleged with someone at Nvidia: vice president Kimberly Powell. The Nvidia board meets in claimed preparation to oust Huang.

content.v: Balls to this.
GTA 6 was, reportedly, very close to being refused classification in South Korea just a couple of months back. The reason? Too many penises.

According to Inven's findings, the country's ratings board — the GCRB — was completely split on its initial classification vote. Three committee members voted for an 'Adults Only' rating, and another three voted to have Rockstar's game refused outright.

items.title: 花费数千美元购买人工智能工具的神奇宝贝粉丝对 Anthropic 终于开始打压感到不满
items.summary: A Pokémon fan who claimed to be spending thousands of dollars each month building a vibe-coded AI project is n

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/12/untitled-1-1794495208363.jpg
A Pokémon fan who claimed to be spending thousands of dollars each month building a vibe-coded AI project is now complaining after Claude AI maker Anthropic finally introduced copyright limitations.

Claude models are now "starting to refuse" to work on projects that include official Pokémon assets, according to Pocket Monster fan Big Kid Nation. In a post on X/Twitter last night, Big Kid Nation went on to lament the fact that no money had ever been made on the project despite significant investment, unlike other similar projects that are being funded through Patreon.

"Anthropic has cracked down and Claude models are starting to refuse work on Pokémon fan projects," Big Kid Nation wrote , attaching a screenshot in which Claude stated it could no longer generate code designed to work with images it detected as featuring official Pokémon designs.

"All that money spent, never took a cent (unlike many others with itch.io, Patreon etc.)," Big Kid Nation continued. "Nintendo. Just make the epic Pokémon game you know we all want. I'll live on the street and work for free if it helps."

Big Kid Nation is currently building "Pokémon Arena 2D," a game that has somehow escaped the beady eyes of The Pokémon Company's lawyers up to this point, but seems unlikely to do so for much longer. "Real-time arena battles in pixel art," reads a description listed on BigKidNation.com. "Two years in the making, and free to play."

In another X/Twitter post made earlier this month, Big Kid Nation claimed they were racking up as much as "$2,000 expenses a month and 10-14 hour days both learning and building for most of this year and last." And while the game was coded using AI tools, Big Kid Nation was keen to push back on those branding it simply as "AI slop."
Big Kid Nation said that they set their PC running overnight simulating battles within Pokémon Arena 2D to try and detect balance issues, and then spent 14 hours a day sitting at the computer itself.

"Vibe coding games is so fun," Big Kid Nation wrote in another post , made last month. "There are some negatives with unethical vibe coders. But you're creative and love game development it's just a dream. What took me a year to make people can make in a week. And some can't make anything original. But those with ideas it's just one thing after another."

As an example of another "original vibe coded project", Big Kid Nation pointed to the separately-developed Poké Derby, which appears to be a Pokémon-themed version of the hugely popular Japanese racehorse game Umamusume. "This is what I'm talking about," Big Kid Nation wrote. "Instead of seeing ideas and just taking them with no creativity, these guys just build their own unique world from scratch."
Numerous comments on this post pointed out the fact this was in fact a Pokémon-themed version of Umamusume, seemingly to no avail.
The next official Pokémon games to release remain Pokémon Winds and Waves , which will arrive exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2 next year. Maybe it's best to just wait for those?

items.title: 《马里奥赛车世界》Switch 2 黑色星期五特惠让价格回到 2025 年水平
items.summary: Nintendo has announced its 2026 Black Friday deals, with a Mario Kart World Switch 2 hardware bundle as the ce

content.v: Nintendo has announced its 2026 Black Friday deals, with a Mario Kart World Switch 2 hardware bundle as the centerpiece for $500.

The Switch 2 launched in 2025 with a similar bundle for the same price, but it was discontinued at the end of the year. It later returned , but at a higher price point--$550. Now, the bundle is on "sale" again, though it's the same price as it was in 2025 before the price hikes. In addition to a digital copy of the game and the console, it comes with a three-month Nintendo Switch Online membership.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Switch2bundle.jpg?w=636

The bundle goes on sale November 22 and will be available through December 5. It's not the only hardware bundle that people can buy, as Nintendo also offers a system with a digital copy of Nintendo Switch Sports Resort and three months of Switch Online for $530. This bundle is not on sale for Black Friday, though.
Get the Mario Kart World Switch 2 hardware bundle here:
Additionally, for just one week--November 22-29--Nintendo will offer games like Donkey Kong Bananza and Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2 for $20 off.
What's more, Nintendo announced that the Nintendo eShop and the Nintendo Store will offer a range of deals November 19-December 2, but it hasn’t yet detailed what you can expect.

Black Friday used to be just one day of deals--the day after Thanksgiving in the US--but now it's an entire season of savings. Keep checking back with GameSpot for more Black Friday deals in the days ahead.

items.summary: IGN发布了对《怪物猎人：旅人》的评测文章，给出了7分的评价。

content.v: IGN发布了对《怪物猎人：旅人》的评测文章，给出了7分的评价。
简评： 《怪物猎人：旅人》巧妙地将该系列狂热的战斗模式适配到了移动端，但其强大的核心玩法却被玩家再熟悉不过的抽卡机制和无休止的菜单所拖累。
评分 7 分
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/12/small_202611122245545693.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/12/small_202611122244226927.jpg

总评： 《怪物猎人：旅人》就是那种塞了太多东西的游戏；它充斥着各种需要去费心管理的移动端式冗余内容，其中很大一部分妨碍了玩家去享受它本身明显具备的强大玩法。在许多方面，《旅人》的野心之大确实令人惊叹，它如此巧妙地将《怪物猎人：世界》的精彩之处整合进了一个体量更小的平台中。对战斗系统的巧妙精简依然保留了狩猎的紧张激烈感，同时让游戏更适合利用碎片时间游玩。虽然游戏里有足够多的优点能让你保持投入，但它也同样伴随着诸多令人沮丧的痛点，比如收费机制、进度卡点，以及无休止的菜单管理带来的烦恼。这意味着，归根结底，《旅人》未能企及其主机版本的高度，但如果你能带着降低后的预期去游玩，怪物猎人的核心灵魂依然存在。

11月11日，零元面馆殷巷店附近一位经营了9年的商户告诉记者，以前一天能做1000多元，现在只有五六百，“差不多减半了”。他说，他们夫妻俩24小时轮流干，从早上7点一直做到晚上三四点，才做700元，对半就300元，去掉房租就剩100元，连房贷都还不起。
这位商户表示，做好事、做慈善，至少要考虑到大局，也要考虑周边商户的处境。“他们也拖家带口，也有压力，不能说你照顾了个别的，把我们的利益损失掉。

玩家们可以通过这张地图，清晰地看到游戏虚拟州“雷奥尼达”（Leonida）的庞大版图以及多个关键地标节点。
不过需要注意的是，这张曝光的实体地图并非十分详尽的1:1游戏内地图，而是一张标有关键地标的概览海报。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/12/small_202611122237268767.jpg
从图片中可以看出，整个地图被设计成了充满复古与漫画风格的观光地图，不仅展示了地形，还印有大量极具佛罗里达特色的趣味插画，如飞艇、火烈鸟、重装皮卡、比基尼女郎、甚至UFO和沼泽怪物。
根据地图上的文字信息，我们可以梳理出以下关键节点：
主要行政区划（郡县）：
Lummox County（位于右上角区域）
Kelly County（位于左上角区域）
Leonard County（位于右侧，包含巨大的Lake Leonida湖泊）
Vice Dale County（位于中下部，核心城市Vice City罪恶都市所在地）
Mariana County（位于左下角，包含沼泽区域）
核心城市与主要地标：
Vice City（罪恶都市）：地图右侧的核心大都市，高楼林立。
K.C. City：位于地图中下方，标志性插画是一个UFO。
Port Gellhorn：左上角的沿海港口城市。
Grassrivers：左下角的沼泽地带。
其他特色区域及岛屿：
群岛：地图四周散布着多个岛屿，包括顶部的Featherstone Islands、左上的Zephyr Islands、右上的Stamford Islands，以及右下角的Gloriana Key、Catalan Key和Corsair Key等。
街区/区域：包括Ambrosia、Emerald Springs、Buckskin Swamp、Little Cuba、Southside以及Pelican Valley等。
交通网络：地图上清晰标注了多条公路编号（如404、183、35、97等），右下角还有明显的“Toll”（收费站）标志。

items.title: 接替黄仁勋的女人什么来头？59岁临时CEO身家惊人
items.summary: 英伟达董事会今日宣布，黄仁勋已辞去公司总裁、首席执行官（CEO）及董事会成员职务。

content.v: 英伟达董事会今日宣布，黄仁勋已辞去公司总裁、首席执行官（CEO）及董事会成员职务。
英伟达现任执行副总裁兼首席财务官（CFO）、59岁科莱特·克雷斯（Colette Kress）已同意出任临时首席执行官。在正式继任者确定之前，克雷斯将继续兼任执行副总裁和首席财务官。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/12/small_202611122228161144.png
以下是关于科莱特·克雷斯介绍：
1. 自2013年起担任英伟达CFO
克雷斯于2013年9月加入英伟达，担任执行副总裁兼首席财务官，并一直任职至今。她经常与黄仁勋一同出席公司的季度财报电话会议。她加入英伟达时，公司当财年的营收为41.3亿美元；到了2026财年，英伟达营收已达到2159亿美元。
2. 加入英伟达前的职业经历
加入英伟达之前，克雷斯曾在德州仪器担任财务相关职务长达8年，随后于1997年至2010年在微软工作。2006年，她升任微软服务器与工具部门首席财务官，负责该部门的财务战略、规划及报告工作。2010年，她加入另一家公司，担任业务技术与运营财务部门高级副总裁兼首席财务官，负责财务战略和业务发展，并于2013年离职，随后加入英伟达。
3. 教育背景与从业经验
根据英伟达提交给美国证券交易委员会（SEC）的年度报告，克雷斯拥有亚利桑那大学金融学理学学士学位，以及南卫理公会大学工商管理硕士（MBA）学位。据《财富》杂志2024年的报道，克雷斯加入英伟达之前，已经在多家大型科技公司从事财务工作近25年。她曾向《财富》透露，2013年刚加入英伟达时，这家公司是她职业生涯中任职过的规模最小的企业。
4. 财富状况
根据《福布斯》2026年美国白手起家女性富豪榜，克雷斯排名第32位。截至周三收盘，她持有的英伟达股票价值约为7.5亿美元。相比之下，在英伟达股价上个月创下峰值时，她所持股票的价值曾超过10亿美元。

items.title: GTA 最奇怪的神话：完整的历史
items.summary: From bigfoot to the Mount Chilliad mystery, GTA has a long history of urban myths. Before GTA 6 adds more to t

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/09/gta-myths-1794236071663.jpg

Grand Theft Auto has always run a second game beyond the boundaries of your controller, a scavenger hunt set in motion by a huge community of secret hunters determined to crack open the series and solve the meta mysteries within.

GTA is a lightning rod for urban legends and a magnet for myths, and hunters will stop at nothing to dig up the cryptids, creepypastas, and cut content that simply must be hidden somewhere in the vastness of each title.

What are the most famous rumors throughout the series’ history? Did any of them turn out to be true? And what does the future hold for sleuths and speculators in the age of leaks and datamining? These are GTA’s strangest myths.
Part 1: Dodos and Darkels

Grand Theft Auto 3 launched after a last-minute, three-week delay out of sensitivity to the September 11th attacks. Not much was actually changed: only about 1% of the game by Rockstar’s own estimate, little things like police car livery and pedestrian barks.

But in the cauldron of conspiracism that was the early 2000s, we wondered what else we weren’t supposed to see. The gray city cast in hazy headlights felt lonely and liminal, with cars that spawned out of nowhere and a feeling that something clandestine was just around the corner.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/10/gtas-strangest-myths-dodohanger-1794328441335.png

Consider the Dodo, a Cessna with clipped wings that barely achieves liftoff. It’s not a massive leap to presume that the aircraft was grounded as part of the 9/11 cuts, or that it was originally part of a mission where it smashed into Donald Love’s towering HQ. Why else would Rockstar model a plane and implement flying controls just to hobble it?

But the Dodo was never intended to fly. A purported design document calls for a “wingless Cessna,” a compromise forced by the PS2’s data streaming pipeline. An airworthy Dodo would outrun the game’s ability to load itself.

There was no technical reason to cut Darkel. The lost character’s existence is well-supported. IGN’s early previews noted a prophet who “says weird things and asks you to do weird things,” and he appears in the design document as a creepy personification of the Rampage missions.

Why the omission? One theory is that his missions were too violent and taboo even for Rockstar. Think El Burro’s Ice Cream Truck mission but worse. Working for an anarcho-terrorist was a non-starter after 9/11, but Darkel was actually axed well before the attacks.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/10/gtas-strangest-myths-darkel-1794328749379.png

Not every character works out, especially when a floating skull icon could do their job with a lot less yappin’. Only fragments remain of Darkel in GTA 3: a name in the credits, an unused texture, and a circle of vagrants who haunt a Harwood tunnel.
The last of his followers, perhaps. Sometimes they have molotovs. No one knows exactly what they are up to, not even your friend’s uncle who works at Sony.

Schoolyards and study halls were the source of knowledge in the days before CCU numbers and open betas. The gaming press served enthusiasts who traded secrets in magazine letter pages and the message boards of hot new websites.
Mags would offer morsels of dirt in return, confirming and debunking rumors and sometimes creating them out of whole cloth, but monthly magazines could only move so fast.
The conversation was heading online, and gamers got there early. By 2001 the internet had grown into a massive incubator for myths and legends. For GTA fans, things were about to get hairy.
Part 2: Bigfoot
Liberty City, as realized in GTA 3, is a tiny place. It’s only about 3 square miles by most measurements, and the O.G. Vice City isn’t much bigger.

2004’s San Andreas is nearly five times the size of LC, an entire state with three whole cities and vast swaths of forest, desert, and farmland between them. There’s more room to explore and get lost in, with plenty of empty space for imagination to fill the gaps.

GTA: San Andreas pushes the aging game engine to its limit, producing lots of little moments of unreality in a game designed to simulate modern(ish) life. Ghost cars roll across the street with no one inside. A photographer flings himself off a cliff. Planes fall from the sky and scorch CJ’s face. All of these glitches in the Matrix can be explained by quirks of the code, but where’s the fun in that?

The anomalies and eerie draw distance fog give the lo-fi world a sense of simulacrum. There’s a haunting unknowability to San Andreas. Step off the beaten path and you’ll end up lost in the woods like a fairy tale. Here there must be monsters.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/10/gtas-strangest-myths-searchingforbigfoot-1794328850237.png

Rockstar excels at cheeky commentary on all things Americana, and it’s not a huge leap to presume that they must have included the country’s favorite cryptid somewhere in the San Andreas wilds. Some call him Sasquatch, the Skunk Ape, or Harry. Most know him as Bigfoot, the missing link of the Pacific Northwest. You’ve probably seen his beef jerky ads.

Bigfoot’s existence in San Andreas was surmised with staggering speed. Within days of San Andreas dropping, yarns were being spun online about mysterious UFOs and phone booths in the desert and a mythical creature roaming the countryside. But the “San Andreas Bigfoot Hunt” wouldn’t really pick up steam until the game came out a second time.

The “Hot Coffee” controversy, in which a scrapped sex minigame was discovered hidden on the disc, resulted in San Andreas being pulled from shelves and re-released without the offending material. There was definitive proof on the national news that Rockstar buried secrets within the game. Anything was possible now, even Bigfoot.

The pursuit of Bigfoot in San Andreas by the blossoming online myth-hunting community mirrors much of the real world search for the elusive beast. There are innocent mistakes, where fleeting glimpses of the mundane are misremembered as hulking monsters. A random pedestrian who mistakenly spawns in the woods can scare us enough to conjure a terrifying ape man in our minds. A creepy growl heard in the Back O’ Beyond woods after hours of searching could be the monster, even if it’s actually just C.J.'s stomach rumbling.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/10/gtas-strangest-myths-gtasabigfoot-1794328884790.png

Much of the “evidence” for the real Bigfoot comes from shaky footage and blurry snapshots, and the same can be said for the San Andreas creature. In the pre-OBS age, when capturing video required dedicated hardware, sightings were shared as poorly-compressed files filmed straight from a smeary CRT. These vague images lack clarity but ooze spooky vibes, and the fuzziness plays a major role in maintaining an aura of forbidden mystery.

Rockstar itself addressed the rumor with co-founder Terry Donovan declaring in no uncertain terms that “there is no Bigfoot, just like in real life.” A doctored version of his quote spread through the community with quite the opposite effect thanks to the apocryphal addendum of “there is something in the woods.”

Bigfoot brings out a lot of fakers. Just ask the countless con artists throughout the decades who spent their hard-earned time on wooden footprints and fictional taxidermy. Even the most famous Bigfoot evidence of all, the Patterson-Gimlin film, was recently, nigh-definitively exposed as a hoax. The GTA myth hunter scene was equally rife with opportunists who shamelessly forged evidence for their pet theories, doubly so when the PC version of San Andreas arrived with the ability to mod in a Bigfoot, snap some screenshots, and stir the pot.

content.v: No longer handheld pricing from DS, 3DS.

Professor Layton and apprentice Luke aren't playing about with small handheld Nintendo DS and 3DS releases anymore; they're in the big leagues now with a proper PS5 and Switch 2 release. Professor Layton and the New World of Steam is the first time the series has appeared on a home console, and the price of the new entry matches that: £53.99 / $64.99.

Compared to previous titles in the franchise, this is a significant price increase — the DS and 3DS games were generally around $30 to $40 at launch, increasing as the series went on. Now, as the New World of Steam plans for a December 2026 release, it'll cost roughly double the price of Professor Layton and the Curious Village , which was the first game in the series.

items.title: 黄仁勋辞职，首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)被任命为英伟达临时首席执行官
items.summary: Company co-founder seemingly ousted following multiple affair scandals.

others.title: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋辞职，立即生效

content.v: Jensen Huang has resigned from his role as CEO and president of Nvidia. He will be replaced by interim CEO, Colette Kress, who had previously worked as the company's CFO for a long stretch.

"Nvidia Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately," a statement on Nvidia's newsroom says.
Jensen Huang has been embroiled in a scandal, or rather a couple of scandals, over the past few weeks.
First, an affair to which he later admitted ; suggested to have been with a datacentre company executive suspected of working for Chinese intelligence.
Second, another alleged affair , this time with an executive at Nvidia.

The markets may get spooked by the announcement, as Huang was a co-founder of the business (founded in 1993, making Huang the longest CEO of a major tech firm) and has overseen the company through its latest and largest success.
The share price for the company had already plummeted to its lowest levels since June 2025 following a report that the company's board was considering ousting Huang.
The company's share price is currently down around 12% in pre-market trading.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UhqwyvNRp86wRWMUYuzDNj-1920-80.jpg

The move to appoint the company's long-standing CFO as interim CEO was an expected one, to help ease the transition from Huang's leadership. Intel did something similar when the company ousted its CEO in 2018.

"Colette Kress, current Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Nvidia, has agreed to serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer. Kress will continue to serve as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer while serving as Interim Chief Executive Officer until a permanent successor has been named. The Board is initiating a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer and will consider internal and external candidates."

Huang has also resigned from his position as president and from his board seat, which may ease some concerns in recent days that his significant stake and power in the company would be tough to expunge should the company board try to push him out.
Now, the job for the remaining Nvidia employees is to find the next full-time CEO . That could take some time.

items.title: 《Marvel Rivals》在使用模组和配置“获得不公平的战斗优势”方面划清了界限，但这无助于玩家寻求解决卡顿问题
items.summary: Guangyun Chen promises an "optimised client" to reduce stuttering and performance issues.

content.v: How far would you go to achieve decent frame rates? Well some Marvel Rivals players have been breaking the rules to try and give themselves a better shot of having a sort of salvageable in-game experience .

Sure, a lot of players using mods and configs are doing so to give themselves the "unfair combat advantage" that Guangyun Chen talks about, using it to dial down the map detail so enemy players stand out more or heightening environmental tells like footsteps. But that doesn't account for absolutely everyone within the community, with some changing their configs to try and remove the stuttering that can plague Marvel Rivals games.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/CvzSCXHqda5B4hr9FvSbdH-1920-80.jpg

Marvel Rivals has always had an issue with its performance. I shrugged it off as teething pain at first but it's been almost two years since release, and not much has changed. Five months ago NetEase released an "experimental feature" to try and dial down the game's insatiable appetite for RAM , and while it reduced the frequency of game crashes, it didn't solve stuttering.

Then the decision was then made in July to enact some changes that could help with the visual clutter players experience during games. It was brought on by the addition of Jubilee, who had particularly messy VFX. I didn't notice much of a change; team fights are still as chaotic, messy, and confusing as ever.

The biggest change for good happened a few months ago when Marvel Rivals managed to shave an impressive 40GB off by completely repackaging its assets. But by and large things haven't improved fast enough, and Guangyun Chen even accepts that players messing with configs for better performance do have a valid point.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/E3QLzqvojqMaPoFoRaniP6-1920-80.jpg

"We also recognise that a core desire behind players using mods or tweaking configs is simply wanting better framerates and a cleaner visual environment," Guangyun Chen adds. "We are actively working on this. In season 11, thanks to the hard work of our programming team, we'll be rolling out an optional, experimental optimised client.

"This optimisation targets the logic load on the CPU during matches. When toggled on, it will provide up to a 10% boost in CPU performance and significantly reduce mid-combat stuttering. You can download the corresponding DLC on PC and then enable this experimental feature directly in the game launcher."

The Marvel Rivals team is also testing a "clearer competitive" VFX setting which sounds like it will essentially do what some are accomplishing with mods and configs right now: "tweaking the visual effects" for every hero to make fights more legible for players. I am, however, not yet convinced. I've been waiting for huge improvements in Marvel Rivals for so long now that I'll only believe it when I see it.

content.v: 近日，黄仁勋陷入巨大舆论风波，英伟达（NVIDIA）今日宣布黄仁勋辞去公司总裁、CEO及董事职务。
而受竞争对手最高层突发地震影响，AMD在资本市场也于近日上演了狂飙行情。
根据最新股票市场数据显示，AMD在常规交易时段表现极其强劲，收盘价报552.90美元，单日大涨37.69美元，涨幅高达7.32%。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/12/small_202611122222115215.png
从单日走势图可以清晰看到，AMD经历了一个激动人心的“深V”反转：早盘一度震荡下挫并触底，但随后买盘疯狂涌入，股价呈直线暴力拉升。
而在随后的盘前交易中，AMD延续了火热势头，股价进一步攀升至562.87美元，盘前再涨1.80%。

items.title: GTA 6 的杰森可以一边喝啤酒一边吃甜甜圈，过上最好的生活
items.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 looks like it will have an impressive attention to detail, and that includes how

content.v: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 looks like it will have an impressive attention to detail, and that includes how one of the main characters, Jason, can drink a beer and eat a donut at the same time. Now that's living.

Rockstar boss Rob Nelson geeked out to The Guardian about GTA 6's finer details, including this one. According to the report, Jason can "take bites of a donut with one hand while sipping a beer with the other."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Jason_Duval_06_e34fd8.jpg?w=636

It’s unclear whether this is under the player’s active control or it just happens. In any event, the report also mentioned how Rockstar paid close attention to "the way that Jason eats a hot dog." These are very important details.

GTA 6 features a body-shaping system, so if Jason, or Lucia, drink a lot of beer and pound hot dogs and donuts, they'll likely gain weight. But that weight can then be transformed into muscle by hitting the gym and pumping out sets .

Another example of Rockstar's attention to detail in GTA 6 is how Jason can buy a six-pack of beer, then start jogging, holding the beers in the crook of his arm. The game shows you the liquid sloshing around in the bottles as he runs.
GTA 6's attention to detail is a little ridiculous , with Rockstar seemingly going all out to create little details that players may never even notice .
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Preloading is underway now, but the game itself doesn't unlock until November 19 at midnight local time.

items.title: 黄仁勋辞任英伟达CEO！显卡会不会更贵更难买?
items.summary: 11月12日，英伟达宣布黄仁勋辞去总裁、CEO及董事职务，即刻生效。CFO科莱特·克雷斯出任临时CEO，董事会启动新任CEO遴选程序。消息…

content.v: 11月12日，英伟达宣布黄仁勋辞去总裁、CEO及董事职务，即刻生效。CFO科莱特·克雷斯出任临时CEO，董事会启动新任CEO遴选程序。消息一出，英伟达美股盘前跌幅迅速扩大至10%。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/12/small_202611122205247573.jpg
编辑观点： 对玩家来说，这场人事地震最值得盯的是英伟达接下来怎么对待游戏显卡这块业务。
老黄在的时候，游戏卡虽然越来越贵，但至少还在出。换个人上来，游戏卡在英伟达内部的优先级会不会进一步往后排，才是真正要命的问题。
游戏业务在英伟达营收里占比已经很小，社区里有人说得直白：“消费级显卡占据人力物力但利润远不及AI算力，换职业经理人上来搞降本增效，砍GeForce部门是最有效的降本方法。”
老黄对GeForce多少还有点情怀，换一个纯粹的职业经理人，游戏卡在资源分配里的位置只会更边缘。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/12/small_202611122205366832.jpg
这意味着两件事。一是供应：先进制程和产能优先给数据中心，游戏卡的供货节奏和型号更新都可能被拖慢。
二是价格：只要游戏业务继续以“不亏就行”的优先级存在，厂商就没有动力压低消费级显卡的价格。短期跌的那几千块，改变不了旗舰卡实际到手价远高于建议零售价的结构性问题。
当然也有乐观的看法：AI基建不可能无限扩张，等数据中心热度过去，游戏卡的价值会重新被捡起来。
说到底，玩家的核心焦虑不在“谁当CEO”，而在于英伟达还愿不愿意认真对待那些花几千上万块买显卡打游戏的人。
你觉得黄仁勋离开后，英伟达的游戏显卡会变得更贵、更难买，还是反而有机会回归正常？评论区聊聊。

items.title: 黄仁勋辞去 Nvidia 的所有职务，立即生效
items.summary: The scandal deepens as an alleged second affair comes to light.

content.v: Nvidia's CEO, Jensen Huang, has resigned as President, CEO, and member of the board, effective immediately. That is the message which has just been posted on the Nvidia newsroom .

He has been at the centre of a big ol' scandal since last week, which threatened his position at the head of one of the biggest companies in the world. It started with a report over his relationship with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset , which moved into him emailing his entire workforce to say sorry that he's had an affair (though didn't name the person), an invite to talk to national security and foreign affairs officials in US Congress next week, and now reports of potentially a second affair , this time with an Nvidia employee, have come to light.
This is what sparked the emergency board meeting last night which has culminated in his resignation from all sectors of the company.

Nvidia CFO, Colette Kress has taken over as interim CEO, while the company searches for a permanent replacement for Jensen, with Harvey C. Jones appointed the virst ever chair of Nvidia's board of directors.

"Colette Kress, current Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Nvidia, has agreed to serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer," reads the statement on the Nvidia newsroom. "Kress will continue to serve as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer while serving as Interim Chief Executive Officer until a permanent successor has been named. The Board is initiating a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer and will consider internal and external candidates."

“Nvidia’s strength has always come from its people, and together with our leadership team, I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years,” said Colette Kress, Interim CEO and CFO, Nvidia. “We will continue advancing the work that has made NVIDIA a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead. Our focus remains on serving our customers, partners, developers and shareholders.”
There has so far been no statement from Jensen himself on the matter, but the Nvidia statement thanks him for his service...

"Jensen’s contributions to NVIDIA are profound. NVIDIA is one of the most consequential technology companies in the world. The Board and the company thank Jensen for his immeasurable contributions to the company and the industry."
Here is a brief timeline of events which kicked off last week with a story by the New York times into Jensen's relationship with Alice Huang.
Tim Sweeney said it "would be an Apple firing Steve Jobs level of idiocy " to fire Jensen Huang from his position as CEO. He suggests it would do grievous harm to the US.

Save Jensen.This would be an Apple firing Steve Jobs level of idiocy from NVIDIA’s board if they did that, and a grievous harm to the United States of America.The dude truly is the visionary driver of the future of tech from the gaming GPU era to CUDA to AI supercomputers. November 12, 2026
Not holding back, he also said it would be a "ridiculous shitshow... to replace one of the leading technology visionaries of the modern era with the company's money guy."

@wallstengine Wow what a ridiculous shitshow it would be to replace one of the leading technology visionaries of the modern era with the company’s money guy. The NVIDIA board would literally be burning the company down at the shareholders expense and grievously harming the USA. November 12, 2026
Elon Musk just said it would be "an honor" to hire Jensen. I'm sure it would, Elon. I'm sure it would.
@zerohedge That would be an honor November 12, 2026
Nvidia's share price has now dropped 13% in pre-market trading.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2hFoA6c4JFU5KCgux89k3V-1920-80.jpg
Reaction to his resignation
Tim Sweeney inevitably has something to say on the matter, as does Clement Delangue, co-founder and CEO of Hugging Face.

This whole thing sucks, and I wish none of it had happened. It’s a really sad day!But I want to make one thing clear: we’ll keep fighting for open-source AI, harder than ever. This is too important to slow down now. Let’s go! November 12, 2026

A sad day for NVIDIA, developers, America, and all humanity. Jensen founded and ran one of the few companies to reach a massive scale while driving massive continued innovation and ubiquity, while others fell into the trap of ever-increasing extraction. November 12, 2026
Jim Cramer, host of Mad Money on CNBC had this to say:
Jensen we hardly knew yah. Just plain awful.... November 11, 2026
Who can replace Jensen?

As interim CEO we have, as many predicted (including our Jacob Fox ) the current Nvidia chief financial officer, Colette Kress. As a short term measure it makes sense for the board to go straight for the money person who's been talking with investors at earnings calls for 13 years now. That's the way to help calm a volatile market, and one that is likely to be spooked losing one of the main proponents for AI.

But what about the long term appointment? Nvidia's board has reportedly employed an outside agency to aid in identifying candidates for the CEO position , but who would want that job? We've got some thoughts as to who might make a good fit, but whether any of them would be keen, or whether the board would be keen on them, is another matter.

CNN correspondent for AI, Hadas Gold, has posted on X what she says are the emails sent out to Nvidia employees today from new CEO, Colette Kress, and its first chair of the board, Harvey Jones. There will apparently be a company meeting on November 18, the same day as Jensen is supposed to visit the US Congress.
Here are the emails sent to Nvidia employees: Company meeting Nov 18 https://t.co/9X67XzSOCe November 12, 2026
Trump wants Tim Cook

Donald Trump has spoken up about his buddy Jensen's resignation, stating that there is only one person for the job: former Apple CEO, Tim Cook. Trump has always spoken very positively about Cook in the past, most especially when talking about his first term in office where he was very impressed with himself "to have the head of Apple calling to 'kiss my ass'" after a phonecall from Cook.

items.title: Popeyes 借《GTA 6》热潮推出全新“香料城”鸡肉三明治
items.summary: Popeyes has unveiled its new "Spice City" chicken sandwich, which is the restaurant's attempt to ride the hype

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/10/popeyes-sandwich-1794351677687.jpg
Popeyes has unveiled its new "Spice City" chicken sandwich, which is the restaurant's attempt to ride the hype wave for GTA 6 .

Popeyes has confirmed that the Spice City chicken sandwich will be available in participating stores on November 19, the same day as Rockstar's highly anticipated release. The fast food chain said this new menu item is meant to "pay homage" to a sandwich in-game (it's unclear what in-game sandwich they are referring to, but there are drive-thrus and restaurants in GTA 6).

The sandwich includes two crispy chicken breast fillets stacked between a buttery, toasted brioche bun, topped with pickles and your choice of spicy or regular mayo. It'll set you back $6 (prices vary by location) and will be available from November 19 through November 22.

A big part of this news is that the sandwich will be available for delivery through the Popeyes app and other food delivery services, so you don't have to leave your house or worry about cooking when GTA 6 releases.

"It’s been reported that a lot of fans will be calling in sick and are clearing their calendars to disappear into the sunniest, most chaotic open world in gaming," reads a Popeyes press release. "Popeyes has the perfect getaway meal and we wanted to let you know now so you can plan ahead."

It's just one of many ways the entire world seems to be getting on board with GTA 6. In addition to a wide-ranging marketing campaign from Rockstar itself , other companies have been attaching themselves to the hype train in unofficial ways. Logitech announced that it will be giving employees the day off for video game releases going forward and will be hosting a special live-streamed event on November 19 to celebrate this perk.

Spectrum and Xfinity are also offering free internet upgrades to allow customers the chance to download GTA 6 faster. It's clear that this has become a major, global event, and companies seem to be helping advertise GTA 6 at no cost to Rockstar. Xbox and PlayStation confirmed that GTA 6 is the most pre-ordered game in both of their respective histories , highlighting the extreme hype for the title. Those who have pre-ordered GTA 6 can pre-load the game now, and they will likely want to because the game is massive.

Rockstar also confirmed that GTA 6 will run at 30fps , but will have a few enhancements for PS5 Pro users. The news came as a bit of a disappointment for some fans who were hoping for a higher frame rate, but there is hope that maybe a potential PC or PS6 port could unlock better performance later down the line.

items.title: 星际：异端先知有一些意想不到的动漫影响
items.summary: After years of post-apocalyptic survival stories and archaeological adventures, Intergalactic: The Heretic Pro

content.v: After years of post-apocalyptic survival stories and archaeological adventures, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet looks like a fresh opportunity for Naughty Dog to showcase a new sci-fi universe. Visually, the game draws on '80s sci-fi movies with analog technology and ancient hardware like CD players, but you can also thank a genre-defining anime film for shaping Intergalactic's look and feel.

In an interview with Patton Oswalt during the Comic Creators Block Party 2026, Naughty Dog director Neil Druckmann said that Akira inspired Intergalactic on multiple levels, alongside other big anime properties like Cowboy Bebop .

"For Intergalactic, we actually took a lot of inspiration from anime. Akira--everybody loves Akira--just like the animation, the big ideas, the kind of philosophical sci-fi ideas within that," Druckmann said. "We took a lot of inspiration from anime, stylistic inspiration, how they approach the story. The big kind of philosophical questions and ideas. We really want to tackle that, and surprise players in interesting ways. By the time you get to the end of Akira, it just goes on this wild ride. And we want to take someone on a similar wild ride."

Druckmann mentioned that he grew up with the laser-disc version of Akira, the landmark 1988 anime film directed by Katsuhiro Otomo. It's not hard to see that influence visually, as the protagonist Jordan A. Mun wears a jacket that looks like it was pilfered from the wardrobe of Akira lead Shotaro Kaneda, and her spaceship also looks like it was manufactured by the same company responsible for the hotheaded biker's iconic motorcycle--maybe we'll even see an Akira slide in the game.

Philosophically, Akira covers a wide range of topics explored over the decades, with the film primarily centered on themes of human technological overreach, spiritual immaturity, and the cyclical nature of creation and destruction. Those ideas have been debated for decades, and Naughty Dog has proven adept at balancing heavy themes with engaging gameplay, particularly in The Last of Us, which balanced a tale of vengeance with shootouts and stealth.
A closer look at its themes isn't too far off either, as Druckmann confirmed that Naughty Dog will have more to share about the game in 2027 .

items.title: 《GTA7》是否会发生在海外？R星：美国仍有空间
items.summary: 《GTA6》的地图重新引入了罪恶都市，此前几部作品的背景设定也在美国其他地区，例如自由城。在一次采访中，R星一位联合负责人谈到了《GTA 7》是否会前往新的国家。R星认为，玩家们目前所看到的只是美国多元化面貌的一小部分。

content.v: 《GTA6》的地图重新引入了罪恶 都市 ，此前几部作品的背景设定也在美国其他地区，例如自由城。在一次采访中，R星一位联合负责人谈到了《GTA 7》是否会前往新的国家。R星认为，玩家们目前所看到的只是美国多元化面貌的一小部分。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794491528_553283_jpg_r.jpg
虽然《GTA6》的庞大地图包含了莱昂尼达的多个区域，但玩家们对罪恶都市却并不陌生。罪恶都市是佛罗里达州的讽刺版本，也是Rockstar Games另一款以美国为背景的游戏。最近的一些迹象表明，《GTA7》的发售可能会比预期更早。在接受《卫报》采访时，工作室联合负责人Rob Nelson谈到了游戏可能采用国际化的背景设定。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794491978_648291.jpg
这座以迈阿密为灵感的都市曾在之前的两款《GTA》系列游戏中出现过，其中最著名的当属2002年的《GTA：罪恶都市》 。然而，《GTA6》庞大的地图规模也带来了无数此前被忽略的区域。R星北方Rob Nelson解释了团队为了还原这些地点所付出的努力。
研究内容包括“在迈阿密夜总会玩到凌晨四点”，然后在几个小时后醉醺醺地去赛车场。开发商还和警察一起值班，并考察了佛罗里达群岛一些风格独特的酒吧。尽管如此，《卫报》还是想知道，换个国家是否会带来令人欣喜的挑战。
当被问及《GTA7》或未来的作品是否会离开美国时，尼尔森回答说：“凡事皆有可能，但美国还有很多事情可以做。”
总部位于苏格兰的R星北方工作室或许比美国本土玩家更热衷于美国的背景设定。即便如此，鉴于《GTA6》的地图展现了美国的另一面，尼尔森认为：“我认为我们对这个版本的美国来说都是局外人。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794491978_852840_jpg_r.jpg
南美之梦
11月19日《GTA6》正式发售时，玩家将可以在比《给他爱5》或《荒野大镖客2》 开放世界 大得多的莱昂尼达大陆上自由探索。不过，2018年的一份泄露文件称，这款新作最初的设计灵感来源于南美洲的部分地区。Rockstar Games证实了“美洲计划”的报道，并透露由于资源紧张，最终不得不缩减游戏规模。
工作室在开发不可避免的《GTA7》时可能不会面临同样的限制。技术总监菲尔·胡克在接受彭博社采访时表示，为《GTA6》设计的引擎可以用于未来的项目。这或许可以弥补研究和渲染外国场景的难度。尽管如此，尼尔森似乎仍然渴望探索一座新的美国城市。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 刘欢已安葬北京怀柔！身患膀胱癌 妻子首度披露死因
items.summary: 新浪热点消息，12日，水均益代发刘欢妻子卢璐的信，

content.v: 新浪热点消息，12日，水均益代发刘欢妻子卢璐的信，信中要点如下：
1、刘欢已安葬在北京怀柔的长城脚下，感谢水均益和毛阿敏的帮助；
2、2012年9月第一季《中国好声音》录制期间，刘欢进行体检时B超发现疑似病兆，复查后显示为膀胱癌，但因为节目录制在即，刘欢选择择日安排切除；
3、活检病理确诊为膀胱原位癌早期，遵从刘欢意愿未曾公开。治疗卓有成效，但五年后复发，医生曾建议刘欢切除膀胱，他说宁死不背尿袋，就这样与病魔缠斗了十几年；
4、20日，刘欢查到CT诊断结果疑似转移，31日当晚刘欢还出席了活动，在现场被冻得要命，回到北京后检查显示癌细胞已全部扩散，且进展很快；
5、首选治疗方案EV+K两轮结束后宣告无效，被告知无传统化疗路可走，于是他们决定尝试试验期的新药，三月去了上海，四月刘欢还接受了《流浪地球3》的邀约；
6、9月1日，刘欢因严重腹泻被送入急诊，两天后转入住院部，期间曾有过好转，结果20日一早他开始高烧，22日零点多情况急转直下，最终无力回天，主要死因写着：感染性休克；
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/12/small_202611122137546501.jpg
信中卢璐还回忆了过往刘欢生活中的点点滴滴，并且感谢了各方帮助。

items.title: 《GTA6》或与电影、流媒体争夺观众时间 收入和影响力可能超过《复联5》
items.summary: 《GTA6》引发的巨大热潮预计不仅仅会掩盖其他电子游戏的光芒。一些分析师认为，这款游戏的收入可能会超过《复仇者联盟5》，并会让观众在相当长的一段时间内远离电影院和流媒体服务。流媒体平台和电影院运营商都担心会失去观众。这种

content.v: 《GTA6》引发的巨大热潮预计不仅仅会掩盖其他电子游戏的光芒。一些分析师认为，这款游戏的收入可能会超过《复仇者联盟5》，并会让观众在相当长的一段时间内远离电影院和流媒体服务。流媒体平台和电影院运营商都担心会失去观众。这种游戏现象会成为整个行业的颠覆者吗?
目前，很少有娱乐产品能像《GTA6》那样引发如此大的关注。这款游戏将于11月19日登陆Xbox和PlayStation平台，几乎每天都有关于它的最新消息涌现。许多其他游戏为了避免与新款GTA正面竞争，都刻意提前或大幅推迟了发售日期。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794490287_583147_jpg_r.jpg
但人们对《GTA6》巨大潜在成功的担忧已不再局限于游戏行业。好莱坞、流媒体平台和电影院运营商也预计，Rockstar Games的这款 开放世界 大作将占据消费者相当一部分的注意力和空闲时间。
游戏大奖主持人兼制作人Geoff Keighley表示，《GTA6）有可能成为史上规模最大的娱乐产品发布。他认为，这款游戏在收入和影响力方面甚至可能超越《复仇者联盟5》和《沙丘3》等票房大片。
Geoff Keighley称，《GTA6》的成功可能会对流媒体服务造成尤其严重的冲击。玩家们预计会将更多空闲时间花在探索《GTA 6》虚构的佛罗里达世界，而不是在Netflix、HBO、Disney+或其他平台上观看电影和电视剧。一部电影两三个小时就能看完，而《GTA6》却能让玩家沉迷数周甚至数月。这得益于其庞大的主线剧情、一个充满各种活动的广阔世界，以及备受期待的长期在线模式。
因此，《GTA6》可能会加速好莱坞早已关注的转变：电子游戏不再仅仅在游戏行业内部竞争，它们现在正与电影和流媒体服务正面争夺观众的注意力。然而，这些担忧是否真的会转化为收视率的下降，还需要几个月的时间才能确定。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 触乐夜话：迟到的秋天
items.summary: 触乐夜话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。 真是色彩缤纷啊！（图/小罗） 从十月初起，我就开始担心降温的问题，频繁地往购物车里塞进一些毛绒绒的鹦鹉小毯子和棉窝。 我家在一个南方边陲小城，在这里，夏天总是非常漫长，

content.v: http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-12/6af58cedf149e.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
触乐夜话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。
从十月初起，我就开始担心降温的问题，频繁地往购物车里塞进一些毛绒绒的鹦鹉小毯子和棉窝。
我家在一个南方边陲小城，在这里，夏天总是非常漫长，炎热的日子严重挤压了春和秋的时间。这也就意味着降温总是猝不及防，可能前一天人还在空调房里吃着雪糕，抱怨新买的秋装没有穿的时间，第二天就会被冷醒。确实也如此，在立冬的早晨，我从空调被中伸出手去够响个不停的手机，被冷空气冻了个哆嗦。
买的货也到了一些，但可能是因为天气还不够冷，李苹果（我的鹦鹉）晚上只会站在棉窝的顶上睡觉。“起码爪子不冷了。”我这样想。
但在白天，李苹果很喜欢站在一个棉帐篷里。这是一个很符合鸟体工学的棉帐篷（至少很适合锥尾鹦鹉），和其他全包的小鸟帐篷不同，它的底部是空的，方便小鸟安置它的长尾巴。
降温以后，我也经常拎着这个帐篷——左手水杯，右手帐篷——走来走去，哪怕只是离开电脑桌去接水，也有一种提前迈入退休生活、我此时正在公园里散步遛鸟的感觉。鸟和人对此都表示特别满意。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-10/1916af29a0b557a3.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
而在这个秋天，我常去的拼豆店倒闭了。
那家店在公园旁的小区楼上，车开不进去，外卖也只能送到楼下。但好在房间整洁干净，桌椅也是年轻店主认真挑选的。所谓的“拼豆店”其实在店主家的跃层，一楼则住着她的白色小狗，有时小狗也会跑到楼上，像一团棉花一样滚进空调开得很足的“拼豆操作间”，引得女孩们放下手里的工具，低头去逗小狗。我在这家店拼的第一个图就是一只顶着苹果的小太阳鹦鹉，这串拼豆被我挂在电脑前的洞洞板上，李苹果经常跑去观察迷你的自己。
但夏天虽然漫长，宝贵的暑假时间却是稍纵即逝的，很多常客在九月份以后只有周末时间有空，更多人也只是在拼豆兴起的时候尝试个一两次。
上个月的周末，我和朋友带着两张大图纸和“雄心壮志”前往。我用着最原始的工具——镊子，拼得很艰难，朋友在旁边提醒我：“你下次一定要买一支拼豆笔来！”
因为选了一张太大的图，朋友在当天只完成了一半，和店主说留到下次再来。
晚上，我收到了店主的信息：“你朋友什么打算什么时候来拼完？”
“明天？”
她则回复道，希望我朋友明天之后再来，比如说，换一个有更多人来的时间。
“不然人太少，空调费都挣不回来，那我就没有动力上班了。”
而朋友在几天后完成的那张拼豆大图，也成了店主朋友圈发的最后一张拼豆照片。过了几天，她开始在朋友圈甩卖自己为了开店购置的所有物品，从18块一张的椅子，到几千块的自动烫豆机。
我买了她六张白色椅子中的四张，和来帮忙的爸爸一起抱着椅子，走向灯光不足的电梯间。店主好像是抱着狗来给我们开门的，好像又不是，只记得和她挥手告别后走的那条走廊好长，我爸担心停在外面的车，催促着我快点走。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-10/7626af29b22e491c.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
早在两个月前，我就在游戏中换上了金灿灿的个人主页背景，做好了迎接秋天的准备；《深空当铺》的轻松熊主题mod也很有“秋天的感觉”，整体的色调看起来也很舒服，是我最近最喜欢的美化mod。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-10/5776af29b477bea2.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-10/2186af29b3d786a5.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
而在立冬前的那一个月，城里几乎所有的花树都开花了，路上随处可见蔓延开的粉色烟雾；家里种的山茶花也开了满头，比春天买来时似乎还要更鲜活；这几天，餐桌上还多了豆青炖排骨这道菜，豆子很清甜，据说是返种的，此时正是当季。

content.v: 一位系列新手向社区寻求建议，想知道该从哪里开始探索《生化危机》的生存 恐怖 世界——结果得到了一个相当明确的答案。剧透一下：它并非系列中评分最高的一作。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794489433_192781_jpg_r.jpg
哪款《生化危机》游戏最适合新手入门?根据玩家社区的说法，它似乎并非评分最高的几款作品之一。在PC平台上，评分最高的应该是《生化危机9：安魂曲》和《生化危机4：重制版》，它们的Metacritic评分分别为92分和91分。然而，在Reddit上，给新手的建议却非常明确：该帖子中点赞数超过700的置顶评论推荐了《 生化危机2 ：重制版》。
2019年的重制版讲述了里昂·S·肯尼迪和克莱尔·雷德菲尔德在浣熊市丧尸横行的街道上艰难求生的故事。游戏注重紧张刺激的探索、解谜以及谨慎的弹药管理。许多玩家认为它是系列作品的绝佳入门之作，因为它融合了系列 经典 的精髓——尤其是令人不安的氛围和生存压力——以及现代化的操作方式和越肩视角。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794489897_822936.jpg
发起讨论的Reddit用户最终选择了《生化危机2：重制版》。然而，对于更喜欢动作元素的玩家来说，《生化危机4：重制版》或许是更好的选择。一条获得超过380个赞的评论推荐了《生化危机2》作为恐怖体验的入门之作，而《生化危机4》则更注重动作元素。在《生化危机4》中，里昂不再需要小心翼翼地穿梭于狭窄的警局走廊，而是经常面对成群的敌人，战斗也因此占据了更重要的地位。不过，游戏中依然不乏恐怖元素。
之后，几乎没有理由不继续玩《生化危机9：安魂曲》，也就是该系列的最新作品。虽然《生化危机》系列游戏的故事彼此关联，但开发商表示，即使没有之前的任何游戏经验，玩家也能尽情享受《安魂曲》带来的乐趣。玩过《生化危机2》或《生化危机4》的玩家应该对里昂这个角色足够熟悉，从而更好地理解游戏中一些对前作的致敬。顺便一提，这三款游戏都可以在Steam Deck上运行。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 丰满美女胸脯跳动!《洛奇英雄传》新作官宣登陆PS5
items.summary: 今日，《洛奇英雄传：反抗命运》（Vindictus: Defying Fate）游戏总监吴东锡（音译）通过PlayStation官方博客发布了一则重要公告，…

content.v: 今日，《洛奇英雄传：反抗命运》（Vindictus: Defying Fate）游戏总监吴东锡（音译）通过PlayStation官方博客发布了一则重要公告，正式宣布这款备受期待的动作RPG将登陆PlayStation 5平台。
视频：
在公告中，吴东锡向PS玩家介绍了本作的核心设计与世界观。本作以受凯尔特神话启发的的中世纪奇幻世界为舞台，主打极具手感与沉浸感的硬核动作战斗。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/12/small_202611122107244892.jpg
以武器为核心的华丽战斗
官方表示，在构思英雄角色时，团队总是先从武器中获取灵感。通过赋予熟悉武器意想不到的机制，创造出独特的战斗体验。各团队在确立整体方向前拥有充分的创作自由，这使得每个英雄都能拥有截然不同的战斗风格。玩家既可以选择精通单一喜爱的英雄，也可以培养多名英雄以应对不同战况。
官方同时展示了四位核心英雄的特色战斗风格：
利斯塔（Lethita）：放弃传统的格挡，以极限闪避为核心。通过连续闪避躲开攻击，并在命中敌人后瞬间突进并打出致命一击。
菲欧娜（Fiona）：手持盾牌，主打稳扎稳打的防守反击。在精准的时机招架敌人攻击，能保持自身攻势不被打断。
黛莉娅（Delia）：擅长蓄力打出毁天灭地的重击，同时具备穿透敌人身体并规避伤害的灵动身法。
卡鲁（Karok）：以吸收冲击的硬核身躯正面硬刚。在强敌攻击的瞬间找准时机，展开力量与力量的巅峰较量。
此外，玩家还可以通过制作专属武器、自定义服装和外观，打造独一无二的英雄。
预言下的残酷世界
本作的世界观围绕一个残酷的预言展开：“只有一个种族消灭另一个种族，才能抵达乐园。”在人类与弗摩尔（Fomoor）长年血染大陆的背景下，玩家将扮演罗切斯特领王国骑士团下属的“卡尔布拉姆佣兵团”的新晋佣兵。在踏上英雄之路的同时，玩家将逐步揭开隐藏在种族对立背后的巨大阴谋。
在探索这片神秘大陆的过程中，玩家将穿梭于多个风格各异的区域，包括人类与弗摩尔交界的前线小村庄“科伦”、曾是中立地带的古代遗迹“北方废墟”、被冰雪覆盖的“冰之溪谷”，以及因神秘事件一夜覆灭的都市“阿尤伦”。
单人冒险与多人共斗
官方确认，本作的旅程主要围绕单人体验展开，但同时为玩家准备了能与他人共同对抗巨大威胁的多人游戏内容。
目前，《洛奇英雄传：反抗命运》的PlayStation Store页面已正式上线，玩家可前往添加至愿望单。

others.title: 埃隆·马斯克延长 Cybertruck 生产以消化积压订单，称必须为“情怀”留出空间

content.v: 消息称，埃隆·马斯克将延长Cybertruck生产，以处理尚未完成的积压订单。原先预计将逐步缩减的生产安排可能因此推迟，但这并不意味着特斯拉已经取消未来的缩减计划。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794488025_753034_jpg_r.jpg
马斯克前一周曾表示，特斯拉计划约在明年年中逐步缩减得州超级工厂的Cybertruck生产，为提高Cybercab产量腾出空间
上周，这位科技亿万富翁证实，特斯拉计划在明年年中左右停止位于德克萨斯州超级工厂的Cybertruck皮卡生产，以便为CyberCab皮卡的增产腾出空间。随后，Cybertruck首席工程师韦斯·莫里尔暗示Cybertruck即将停产。
但马斯克今天表示，Cybertruck皮卡生产将延长至2027年夏季末。他没有给出确切的停产日期，但对这一决定发表了一些评论，他说：“顺便说一句，从利润最大化的角度来看，这并不是最明智的做法，但这个世界总得有点感性的空间，否则还有什么意义呢?”
造型棱角分明的Cybertruck于2023年高调发布，但销量却不尽如人意。事实上，自2019年发布以来，这款卡车就一直饱受网络嘲讽，当时马斯克本人在一次现场演示中不慎打碎了其号称坚不可摧的玻璃。
尽管马斯克和Cybertruck的粉丝都对这一消息表示欢迎，但这并不意味着特斯拉将长期致力于该车型的生产。目前，特斯拉的重心放在了Cybercab上，马斯克曾表示，Cybercab将在特斯拉的无人驾驶出租车计划中扮演关键角色。据路透社报道，这款双座无人驾驶出租车目前仍处于小规模项目，今年年初才开始生产。特斯拉公布的产能超过12.5万辆。

content.v: 消息称，《GTA6》在韩国接受评级时一度接近被拒绝分级。委员会首次表决未能形成决定，游戏经历延期和会议取消后，最终于10月16日取得成人级。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794487330_925547_jpg_r.jpg
相关说法援引韩国媒体Inven Global及韩国游戏内容分级委员会的会议记录。委员会于9月10日首次投票，支持成人级与主张拒绝分级的票数均为3票。出于安全考虑，可游玩的审查版本直到9月28日才交给委员会。10月2日的会议以需要充分研究玩法为由延期，10月8日的会议又因人数不足取消。10月16日，游戏最终以8票赞成、1票反对通过评级。
消息称，审查讨论的主要障碍并非 暴力 、犯罪或毒内容，这些部分被认为与《给他爱5》相近。争议主要集中在游戏于任务背景和一般地点中较频繁地呈现男性生殖器裸露。审查者同时指出，相关地点不存在性互动；玩家若攻击果体非玩家角色，游戏中的警察会将玩家逮捕。
杰森与露西娅的亲密过场据称无法互动，画面只呈现裸露胸部，不展示生殖器。目前尚无明确结论能够确认委员会是否曾要求Rockstar为评级修改游戏内容。

content.v: 距离《GTA6》正式发售仅剩一周，近日，有玩家在英国曼彻斯特的Selfridges百货商店内拍到了一张《GTA6》收藏版地图，部分此前未公开的游戏地点名称也因此提前曝光。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/12/small_202611122035035937.png
据照片显示，Selfridges店内正在展示《GTA6》收藏版套装，其中的折叠地图被部分展开并摆放在展柜中。由于地图上的部分内容清晰可见，一些尚未正式公开的游戏内地点名称随之进入玩家视野。
根据曝光照片及玩家分析，地图上可以辨认出多个新地点名称：
Southwind：Goose Key（鹅岛）上的一处小型定居点。
Pelican Valley：位于Grassrivers（草河沼泽地区）的一处地点。
北部地区：可以看到Lummox County（卢莫克斯县），以及Moreau、Manzana等地名。

items.title: Humble Bundle 的新重新设计莫名其妙地删除了 2 因素身份验证，极大地削弱了帐户安全性
items.summary: I recommend removing your saved payment details, at least for now.

content.v: Users of Humble Bundle —the pay-what-you-want game-bundle storefront that will also sell you books and software—have been alarmed by a new redesign that seems to have axed a foundational piece of login security tech.

The just-released new Humble Bundle website has no support for two-factor authentication whatsoever: users are unable to add it to their accounts, while those who had previously set it up on the old site design (including yours truly) are able to log in with just an email and password. At no point in the login process does the site ask you to input a 2FA code.

Humble Bundle does not address the removal of 2FA anywhere on its new site. In fact, the site's FAQs still feature articles encouraging users to make use of it to keep their accounts secure, which is currently impossible. I have reached out to Humble Bundle to ask if the change was intentional and if it will be reversed, and will update this piece if I hear back.

This is, to put it mildly, concerning. The point of two-factor (or multi-factor) authentication is to make user accounts—which, on Humble Bundle, may well have credit card info saved to them—more secure. Even in the event your account password became compromised, your attacker would be unable to get into your account without also having access to your 2FA codes, which are constantly regenerated and only valid for short periods of time. In a world where too many people have bad password hygiene, it's a vital bit of security tech.

Unsurprisingly, Humble Bundle users are aghast at the uncommunicated weakening of their account security. "This is insanely bad, they need to take down password changes entirely until this is fixed", wrote one user in the Humble Bundle subreddit . "I can't even see a way to remove saved payment details anymore, this is seriously dangerous and the site should be taken offline until fixed ASAP", wrote another . They all, uh, they all pretty much go like that. No one is happy about this.

I have to imagine this was not an intentional change. Indeed, I can't fathom the circumstances under which it would be intentional. Either way, while 2FA's absence endures, you might want to play it safe and remove any saved payment details you have tied to your account, though some users report having trouble doing that, too.

content.v: 独立开发者Oleg Fedorov公布了PC模拟游戏《月面作业员（MOONWRIGHT）》，Steam商店页面现已开放，游戏计划于2026年第四季度推出，并支持日语显示。玩家将在地球住所远程经营月球采矿公司，操控探测车开采和出售资源。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794486440_966130_jpg_r.jpg
游戏的核心机制是地月通信产生的单程1.3秒延迟。玩家发出的指令要经过1.3秒才会抵达探测车，屏幕影像同样滞后1.3秒，驾驶、刹车和钻探均需提前判断。玩家必须细调方向与制动时机，才能让探测车准确停在矿床上方。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794486446_515678_jpg_r.jpg
游戏包含八种资源，从价值较低的月壤到陨石坑中的冰和氦-3，售价每天都会变化。采矿收入可用于升级钻头、货舱、电力和行驶性能，同时还要偿还每周1350美元的债务；连续三次逾期后，银行将收走玩家的全部资产。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794486457_459251_jpg_r.jpg
矿区设在阿波罗17号着陆的陶拉斯-利特罗谷，面积约两平方公里。月昼与月夜各持续约两周：白昼温度最高约111摄氏度，可能导致钻头过热；夜间温度约零下180摄氏度，会降低电池容量并增加耗电。玩家需要依据环境变化安排采矿作业和能源使用。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794486727_316699_jpg_r.jpg
关于此游戏
准备好探索月球、开采它的资源吧。
你是一家只有一个人的采矿公司。你买下了一座基地，租了一辆二手采矿月球车，并花钱把它投放到月球上。它在那里。你在这里，坐在地球上的一把椅子上，面前是三台显示器和一份还款计划。
月球车自己什么也不会做。它开的每一米、钻的每一个孔，都要你通过一条回应总是慢半拍的无线电链路亲手操作。找到值钱的东西，挖出来，运回基地，卖掉，按时还款。然后让月球车变得没那么笨，再往更远处去，那里才有好东西。
游戏特色
实时驾驶，单程信号延迟 1.3 秒
阿波罗 17 号山谷中一块 2 km 的采矿区，由你自己的雷达绘制地图
游戏中可以赢得的 3 个额外任务：拍摄阿波罗 15 号着陆点、在沙克尔顿陨石坑内采冰，以及营救一辆失踪的月球车
8 种月球资源，价格每天变化
真实的月球温度：从正午的 +111 °C 到黎明前的 −180 °C，历经两周的白昼和两周的黑夜
5 棵升级树，以及 7 个会磨损、故障并需要维修的月球车部件
三屏操作员控制台：月球车画面、财务、维修与升级
时间加速，从 x1 到 x1800
38 个奖项，可以摆上你的墙面、架子和桌面，也会出现在你的 Steam 账户中
延迟就是游戏
每条指令都在你发出 1.3 秒后才到达月球车，你看到的每一帧画面也都是 1.3 秒前的。提前刹车。小幅点按转向。正好停在矿床上方是一门技术，而你会越来越熟练。
勘探、钻探、运输
发出雷达脉冲，驱散地图上的迷雾。开到每个信号点旁，它会自动完成化验。停在矿床上方开钻：八种真实的月球资源，从毫无价值的风化层到阴影陨石坑里的冰和氦-3。
每次出车都是一场赌注
电量、货舱和磨损都有限，而下一条矿脉总是那么诱人。在远离基地的地方耗尽电量，集团会把你拖回家——当然要收费。时钟从不停止，充电要花好几个小时。
债务就是倒计时
每周要还 $1,350，外加月球车的租金。矿石不等于钱：它会一直堆在库存里，直到你付钱让穿梭机来运走，而价格每天都在变。什么时候卖，和挖什么一样重要。错过三次还款，银行就会收回一切。
月球的真实模样
你的采矿区是陶拉斯-利特罗谷中的两公里，阿波罗 17 号就在这里着陆。太阳和地球都位于它们在这片天空中真实应在的位置，月球上的一天长达一个月。你的月球车能熬过两周的黑夜吗?温度关系到每一个计划：阳光下钻机会过热，黑暗中电池会变冷、容量下降，还要把你开车所需的电量花在给自己保温上。你只能听到通过月球车本身传来的声音。
让月球车不那么笨
五棵升级树：驱动与电力、钻机与货舱、传感器、自动化，以及基地物流。部件会磨损，需要维修。
赚够了钱，就可以把部分工作自动化，或者干脆继续亲自驾驶和钻探。

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/05/29/marvel-super-heroes-play-booster-box-sale-amazon-best-deal-1780054155676.png

Black Friday is just a couple of weeks away, but if you’re looking to build out an instant collection of Magic: The Gathering cards, you can do a lot worse than this Marvel Super Heroes Play Booster box.

Amazon has cut a huge 40% off the price of the box of 30 packs , netting you a whole host of cards for just $129.99 instead of $209.70. If you want to jump into Magic’s latest Marvel set, this is the way to do it.
Magic’s Marvel Super Heroes Set Just Got An Early Black Friday Discount

At this price, each pack in the box drops from $6.99 (the standard price for a Universes Beyond Play Booster) down to $4.30, with a rare and a foil in each pack. If you’re splitting a box with a friend, you’re getting plenty for your combined outlay.

It’s worth noting that we’re talking Play Boosters in this deal, and not Collector Boosters. Those are, admittedly, much more likely to contain the rarest cards in the set , but they also cost around $40 per pack. Play Boosters, as the name suggests, are ideal for, you know, playing Magic: The Gathering - although that’s not to say there aren’t good cards within.

While there’s no box topper promo card as you’d get with the Hobbit Play Booster Box, this is a steep enough discount to make it an ideal choice for any Marvel fan looking to get into Magic, or a Magic fan looking to catch up on one of this year’s sets.

items.title: 如果黄仁勋走了，谁能替代他？如果英伟达首席执行官因婚外情丑闻而被罢黜，董事会可能会选择以下人选
items.summary: Likely someone safe and internal in the short-term, but the doors are wide open in the long-term.

content.v: It was bad enough for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang that he admitted to having an affair with someone , who people believe to be someone suspected of being a Chinese spy. But it's now come to light he has reportedly had a second affair with a member of Nvidia staff —Kimberly Powell, VP of healthcare. After this latest story it's looking more likely that Huang could be forced to resign.

The question is what's next for Nvidia if the board today decides his tenure as the longest-serving Silicon Valley CEO should come to an end. Huang has been the image of the company in the eyes of the public for a long time, so whoever steps in to replace him will have a big leather jacket to fill. And whoever it is, it will be a major change for the company regardless.

The doors are wide open for Nvidia in the long-term, so it's difficult to pin down with any certainty who any eventual replacement CEO would be, but in the interim the options are more limited. Here's who we could consider seeing as the new CEO of Nvidia.
The potential candidates
Who could it be?

The first thing to note is that if Huang does get the boot, Nvidia will need to appoint someone to the position quickly as an interim CEO. As one of the biggest companies in the world and a major player in the AI industry which is keeping large parts of the US economy afloat, trying to quickly mitigate economic concerns will be key. This would likely mean picking someone internal to Nvidia.

Top of the list here is Nvidia CFO Colette Kress. If you've listened to Nvidia earnings calls, you'll have heard Kress talking to investors about how the company's doing. Kress could be a likely pick for interim CEO because she's known to investors and heads up company finances. In the short term, to investors she'd seem a safe bet to keep the company in good financial standing amidst any damage Huang's controversies may have done to Nvidia's long-term future.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/vQaLsmVXXba7sYHMVMMmKT-1920-80.jpg

Other options internal to Nvidia aren't out of the question, either. Jeff Fisher is especially noteworthy because he's very public-facing, but he is very much couched in the world of gaming as SVP of the GeForce department. Kress would still likely be a safer bet for investors.

Chief technology officer, Michael Kagan, is another option, and would potentially be a good fit as co-interim CEO alongside Kress. Kagan joined Nvidia as part of the Mellanox acquisition, a company which he co-founded. He is also a former Intel engineer having managed the design of the Pentium MMX chips.

The other Nvidia staff I listed are an option, too. Malachowsky perhaps not so much—he's a co-founder but is very hands-off and maybe doesn't have much real involvement with the company from a leadership position.

Any interim CEO that's picked could be there for a while. When Intel CEO Brian Krzanich resigned in 2018—under vaguely similar circumstances to those Huang finds himself under now—both he and Pat Gelsinger were followed by interim CEOs for months before final decisions were made on their successors. Though in Krzanich's case, the interim successor, Robert Swan, went on to become full CEO for another two years.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/J2dBKnCMTXj3nRakjF4RZM-1920-80.jpg

In the long-term, the net for Huang's replacement could be cast far and wide. People like Tim Cook and Elon Musk would be pretty outside bets, but with the monopolistic and 'in-bed-together' state of Big Tech in the US, it wouldn't be out of the question. Remember that Nvidia is the biggest profiteer of the AI boom by far , so an offer would be enticing.

AMD's Lisa Su would be an interesting choice, too, and has been touted by a number of people. She certainly has a combination of GPU and AI engineering prowess alongside general public trust and goodwill. In fact, I can't think of many tech CEOs that the public hate less (an increasingly relevant metric, these days).

Then there is also the consideration of who would want to take the job. Sure, it would guarantee a big pay check, but it's a big role to fill with Nvidia's current very flat hierarchy, and any CEO is going to have to be across everything the company does. It's also a role under intense political and economic scrutiny and with the potential for an AI pop still on the horizon, the company might be sitting on a precipice.

Of course, the board of directors could throw us a wild card, and on that front your guess is as good as mine. Though one thing is very likely, whoever comes in is probably not going to have PC gaming much in their thoughts.

items.title: 顽皮狗新作已经完全可玩！尼尔确认游戏新进展
items.summary: 自顽皮狗（Naughty Dog）于2024年底公布科幻新作《星际：异端先知》（Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet）以来，官方一直保持沉默…

content.v: 自顽皮狗（Naughty Dog）于2024年底公布科幻新作《星际：异端先知》（Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet）以来，官方一直保持沉默。近日，工作室负责人尼尔·德鲁克曼在接受采访时终于透露了该作的最新开发进展。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/12/small_202611122012477228.jpg
在参加2026年Comic Creators Block Party活动接受Patton Oswalt采访时，德鲁克曼被问及这款新IP的进展。尽管他依然严守口风，拒绝透露具体的剧情信息，但他明确表示：“我们目前处于制作的最后阶段，游戏已经可以完全游玩了。我们正在对其进行细化和打磨，我迫不及待想把它展示给世界。”
此前有传闻称，该作的目标发售年份为2027年，且为了保证进度，顽皮狗员工甚至再次经历了加班赶工。结合德鲁克曼“已经开始打磨”的表态，外界推测游戏的实际发售时间可能比预想的要早，或许能在2027年春季或上半年与玩家见面。
关于未来的宣发计划，德鲁克曼承诺明年将展示大量内容：“我们明年会展示很多东西，包括实机演示和更多的故事内容。”他特别强调，顽皮狗会给玩家带来惊喜：“我认为我们会让人们大吃一惊，玩家所以为的游戏内容，和它实际的样子会有很大不同。”此外，他还提到本作拥有“非常庞大的演员阵容”，但团队希望玩家通过亲自游玩去发现这些角色，而不是在早期的宣发中被剧透。
目前，《星际：异端先知》尚未公布具体的发售日期，但显然开发工作已经进入了冲刺阶段。

items.title: IBM发布新一代量子处理器 明年扩展至1000量子比特
items.summary: IBM宣布，推出Nighthawk r3，这是新一代量子处理器。其支持在520个量子比特上执行1万次量子运算，可实现规模更大、更复杂的计算任务，助力IBM推进其量子处理器发展路线图。IBM计划明年将两个Nighthawk

content.v: IBM宣布，推出Nighthawk r3，这是新一代量子处理器。其支持在520个量子比特上执行1万次量子运算，可实现规模更大、更复杂的计算任务，助力IBM推进其量子处理器发展路线图。IBM计划明年将两个Nighthawk r3连在一起，组成一个拥有超过1000量子比特的系统，进一步提高性能上限。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794485506_555324_jpg_r.jpg
IBM在今年9月推出了Nighthawk r2，支持在120个量子比特上执行7500次量子运算。其高速量子比特重置技术显著缩短了电路执行之间的间隔时间，使应用程序能够更高效地收集复杂计算所需的数百万甚至数十亿个样本。包括E.ON、Algorithmiq和Q-CTRL在内的IBM客户与合作伙伴已在Nighthawk r2上执行超过340亿条电路，报告称速度相比IBM以往的量子处理器提升高达19倍。
随后IBM将一项利用 Algorithmiq模拟异构量子材料的实验扩展到Nighthawk r2，使得电路执行速度比原始实验快了8倍。
Nighthawk r3在Nighthawk r2的基础上将高速架构扩展到更大型的量子计算机，总共可处理2034个物理量子比特。在保留Nighthawk r2的方形晶格连接和快速运算能力同时，引入了10个芯片间互连（称为 l 型耦合器），将处理器连接成更大的系统。
另外IBM今年还验证了两项关键技术，使得模块化量子计算成为了可能，也增强了将Nighthawk扩展至更大规模量子计算机的信心。
IBM使用四个 L 型耦合器连接了Nighthawk r1，实现了99.3%的量子态传输保真度，并朝着99.9%的目标迈进。IBM还首次将两个低温模块集成到单个系统中，在不到五天的时间内达到工作温度，并将温度冷却到15毫开尔文以下。
IBM最近与橡树岭国家实验室及AMD合作推出了一个新的量子纠错协同设计平台，将Nighthawk与ORNL的Umbra高性能计算（HPC）系统放在一起，由AMD Instinct MI355X GPU和第五代EPYC CPU提供支持。

items.title: 由于演员的健康问题，新的《巫师 3》DLC 使用人工智能来修饰杰洛特的波兰语声音
items.summary: Has the blessing of Jacek Rozenek. CD Projekt Red has worked with an AI voice generation company on next year'

content.v: CDPR确认，《 巫师3：狂猎 》新DLC“ 旧时曲” 将使用Respeecher技术调整杰洛特的波兰语配音。演员Jacek Rozenek仍会亲自录制新台词，相关技术不会取代其表演，而是让新录音更接近他在2019年中风前留下的声线，使新旧对白衔接得更加一致。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261112/1794431316_492936_jpg_r.jpg
Rozenek表示，这项工作的目标是让声音尽量接近自己12年前的状态，他对游戏创作者及其处理方式抱有很高信任。整个流程已获得演员知情同意，制作团队还设置了人工审核环节，对每段对白逐一检查。
CDPR本地化制作人Mikołaj Szwed承认，人工智能是配音社群高度关注的问题。他认为，在演员知情同意、继续参与表演且结果接受人工审查的情况下，这种技术运用属于较为合乎伦理的方式。
此次调整仅涉及波兰语演出。Doug Cockle负责的英语版杰洛特对白不会采用相同处理。《巫师3：狂猎》新DLC“旧时曲”将于2027年推出。

items.title: 因第二次黄仁勋事件指控，英伟达股价暴跌——这家人工智能公司可能损失数千亿美元的价值
items.summary: That's just under 10% of the company's market cap.

content.v: With a Democratic midterm win, a mini AI crash in China , and Jensen Huang admitted to an affair this Sunday , Nvidia was already in a tight spot. Now, a second affair allegation has come out about Nvidia's CEO, and the AI company's share price has taken a hit as a result.
This reported second affair is said to be with another Nvidia exec, Kimberly Powell, and now the GPU company turned AI company is investigating whether or not it should oust the long-time CEO.
Naturally, that instability is worrisome to some investors, who appear to be signalling distrust towards the company in light of these scandals.

To put the stock dip into perspective, at close on Friday, Nvidia stock was worth $188.70 a share, a dip from a high of $239.24 on October 6. This morning, after-hours trading puts it at $161.88 , as of the time of writing. We haven't seen a share price as low as this for Nvidia since well over a year ago, at the end of June 2025.

With this after-hours trading figure in mind, Nvidia's market cap (share price multiplied by outstanding shares) works out to around $3.93 trillion, which is just under half a trillion less than its market cap before the affair with Alice Huang came out (between $4.3 and $ 4.5 trillion).

Accounting for a share price of $173.73 at close yesterday, that would make a $300 billion dip overnight (from $4.2 to 3.9 trillion). Naturally, one can't assume that downward trajectory will continue to decline, but if Huang is in fact let go, Nvidia shares could see a further drop.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/aSTxQ4YwGLDCb76EUatHWV-1920-80.png

This doesn't mean Nvidia will be closing its doors tomorrow. In fact, it's still a hugely valuable company that remains a market leader in the AI hardware arms race. If you want a top-of-the-line AI chip, you're going to Nvidia before anyone else. And AI has proven to be excessively valuable over the last few years, turning Nvidia into the most valuable company in the world at one point (though Apple has since surpassed it).

Still, as the Nvidia board ruminates on whether or not to get rid of arguably its figurehead at this point, it's unclear where the company goes next and what it will do to regain that value. My bet is more and more AI and sadly not more affordable gaming GPUs. Sorry, people.

content.v: 由你来说： 《GTA6》的最新实机，疑似曝光了游戏中的一项系统， 《GTA 6》中的NPC会实时发布网络内容，甚至能以NPC的第一人称视角，将玩家前几分钟刚做过的事情拍摄并发布出来。对此你认为可能吗？
近日，《GTA 6》公开了最新的实机演示，其极度逼真的画面不仅在玩家群体中引发轰动，更有细心的网友通过画面细节，推测此前关于游戏的一项深度爆料可能是真实的。

有网友发文指出，此前曾有传闻称，《GTA 6》中的NPC会实时发布网络内容，甚至能以NPC的第一人称视角，将玩家前几分钟刚做过的事情拍摄并发布出来。在最新公布的两段类似“游戏内短视频”的实机画面中，网友发现其中存在强烈的关联：第一个视频中红圈标注的正在拍摄的NPC，其站位和拍摄内容，似乎正是第二个视频中所展示的街边豪车画面，且场景中的路人NPC等细节都能一一对应。尽管在车辆颜色和NPC视角上存在微小差异，但这似乎从侧面印证了“NPC实时反馈”系统的存在。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/12/small_202611121939451698.jpg
这段以假乱真的画面让不少玩家惊叹不已，社区反应十分热烈。许多玩家表示，自己第一眼甚至分不清游戏和现实：“这段视频太变态了，分不清游戏和现实了”、“我第一遍看还以为现实的，后面看了几次车窗下面和路人才看出是游戏”、“我还以为你发的洋抖（TikTok），居然是游戏吗？！”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/12/small_202611121940186545.jpg
与此同时，面对近期关于游戏“仅30帧”的争议，不少玩家在此次极致的画质面前选择了妥协。有玩家表示：“如果我们玩到的就是这样，那真的已经是本世代主机的极限了，管他30不30，这在我心里就是满分，无敌的存在。”也有玩家直言：“我是很反感30帧，但如果真做到这种画质，30帧我也认了。画质和帧数无非就是取舍。”
